classification.difficultyReason: Cosine rule for an angle then SAS area, with an obtuse angle.

content.prompt: Use cosine rule to find an angle, and hence calculate the area of this triangle to 1 d.p.

answer.worked:
Let $\theta$ be the angle opposite the $11\text{ m}$ side.
$$\begin{align*}\cos\theta&=\frac{6^2+8^2-11^2}{2(6)(8)}\\\theta&=\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{-21}{96}\right)\approx102.6^\circ\end{align*}$$
Using the unrounded angle,
$$\begin{align*}A&=\frac12 ab\sin\theta\\A&=\frac12(6)(8)\sin\!\left(\cos^{-1}\!\left(\frac{-21}{96}\right)\right)\\A&\approx23.4\text{ m}^2\end{align*}$$
